paper_metadata.title: Studies on high-temperature stability and strengthening mechanisms of high/medium-entropy alloys for potential nuclear applications: The case of FeCrV-based alloys

evidence.quote: High-temperature stability and strengthening mechanisms of high/medium-entropy alloys (HEAs/MEAs) have been studied for Ti-added FeCrV-based MEAs.
